reviews.text: Jordan Valley Retrievers did a fantastic job training my lab.  Amazing results.  I strongly recommend this outfit.  Eddie is trustworthy and does what he says he’s going to do!
We had a great experience with Jordan Valley Retrievers. Our dog came back very well trained and will continue to use them in the future.

I use Jordan Valley Retriever's for boarding and appreciate Eddie's facilities and the plenty of acreage he has for the dogs to run. I can tell that my dog (a Boykin Spaniel) enjoys his time there as well.

Have trusted Eddie with our lab for over 2 years now, both training and boarding. He was able to get our high energy pup dialed in with obedience and is always willing to help with re-training needs. Would recommend him to anyone looking for training or boarding in the DFW area!

UPDATE! Got another and this guy is better than the last! Amazing training!!

After growing up with Labs trained by Eddie there is no way to have one without his training. Highly recommend his training and his dogs.

Can’t rave enough about Eddie and JVR. We trust his expertise and commitment to our dog. He trained our setter rescue and continues to work with him when we board him on the property. We are grateful for Eddie’s ability to handle our high maintence dog. We will always trust JVR with any future hunting / herding dogs my wife and I get.

I started using Eddie 3 years ago after my long time trainer retired.  I had a very poorly trained 18 month old female Lab.  Eddie did a great job fixing her.  We had a great duck season together in the 2022-23 season. Sadly, she died of pythiosis, a very rare situation.  Eddie was very supportive during this period and worked to find me another dog.  We were successful.  I found an 18 month-old partially trained dog.  Eddie has worked with my new male Lab in several 2 month intervals over the past year.  I am very pleased with where my dog is now and have high expectations for how he will perform this upcoming duck season.

I use Eddie to board my dog as well.  I am often gone for 2 or more weeks at a time.  My dog is very happy and safe there.  He gets lots of exercise and interaction with other dogs.

I give my highest recommendation of Eddie Hicks

My Golden has turned into a rockstar after Eddie trained her for 6 months. She has turned into the best waterfowl dog I have owned and she is my third Topbrass. She will be competing this spring after the season. Best trainer I have ever worked with. Thanks Eddie
